beats.en: Make way! Don't block the porters!

as.guan: 官人，這是自家的糧，稅都納了。
as.shi: 相公，京城米貴，這船糧值錢哩。
as.li: 兄弟，來扛袋麼？一袋幾文錢。
as.seng: 師父，卸完了，捨你一升米。
as.jun: 軍爺，自家的私糧，不勞押送。

asEn.guan: Sir, this is my own grain. The duties are paid.
asEn.shi: Sir, rice is dear in the capital. This boatload is worth plenty.
asEn.li: Brother, want to carry sacks? A few coins a sack.
asEn.fu: Madam, it's busy here. Keep to the side.
asEn.tong: Kid, don't climb the grain sacks!
asEn.seng: Master, when we're done I'll give you a measure of rice.
asEn.jun: Soldier, it's private grain. No escort needed.

beats.text: 一路從南邊來，可乏死了。
beats.en: All the way up from the south. I'm worn out.
Forty-one sacks. Noted!

beats.text: 穩著些，莫把袋子摔破了。
beats.en: Steady. Don't burst a sack.
Got it. Go!
Still here? Watch me count the grain.

asEn.guan: Rest easy, sir. Every sack is counted.

beats.en: Forty-two, forty-three…

beats.text: 點仔細了，一袋也少不得！
beats.en: Count carefully. Not one sack goes missing!
One tally stick a sack. Can't go wrong.

beats.text: 京城糧價，一日高似一日。
beats.en: Grain in the capital costs more every day.

as.guan: 官人也知道，如今糧價不低。

asEn.guan: You know it, sir: grain isn't cheap these days.

beats.text: 先存進巷裏的倉，等個好價。
beats.en: Into the store down the lane first. Wait for a good price.

beats.text: 連個押糧的官兵都沒有。
beats.en: Not one official or soldier guarding the grain.
Less talk. Go carry sacks!

beats.text: 客官打哪兒來？郊外亂著呢。
beats.en: Where are you from, friend? It's chaos out in the fields.

as.tong: 小娃兒，郊外驚了馬，莫亂跑！
as.li: 兄弟，歇歇腳，喝碗水再走。

asEn.guan: Please sit, sir. It's cool under this shed.
asEn.fu: Sit down, madam. A horse bolted out there.
asEn.tong: Kid, a horse bolted out there. Don't run about!
asEn.li: Brother, rest your feet. A bowl of water, then go.

beats.en: There, there. Don't be scared. We're here.

beats.text: 方才一匹馬驚了，衝進集上。
beats.en: Just now a horse bolted and charged into the market.
Was anyone hurt?
My donkey jumped with fright too.
Want to hear more? Sit, I'll tell you.

asEn.guan: You'd hear more, sir? Please sit.

beats.text: 是踏青回城的人家的馬。
beats.en: It was the horse of a family back from the spring outing.

beats.text: 有個老漢，急忙喚孫兒回家。
beats.en: An old man hurried to call his grandson home.

beats.text: 清明人多，路上可得當心。
beats.en: Crowds at Qingming. Mind yourself on the road.
Listen. Whose child is crying?

asEn.guan: Listen, sir. Whose child is that crying?

beats.en: A neighbour's, maybe. Loud enough!
One wail, and the whole shed turns round.

beats.text: 卸了行李，歇夠了再進城。
beats.en: Baggage off. We'll rest, then into town.

beats.text: 借問，這可是王家紙馬鋪？
beats.en: Excuse me, is this Wang's paper-horse shop?

as.guan: 官人，這可是王家紙馬鋪？
as.seng: 師父，清明了，可替人念經？
as.shi: 相公，那招牌寫的可是王家？

asEn.guan: Sir, is this Wang's paper-horse shop?
asEn.seng: Master, it's Qingming. Do you chant for the dead?
asEn.tong: Little one, where's the paper shop's keeper?
asEn.shi: Sir, does that sign say Wang?

beats.text: 紙錢紙馬，疊得跟樓閣一般高。
beats.en: Paper money and horses, piled as high as a pavilion.

beats.text: 清明這幾日，紙馬鋪最忙。
beats.en: These Qingming days, the paper shops are busiest.

beats.text: 買些紙錢，明日出城上墳。
beats.en: I'll buy paper money and go out to the graves tomorrow.
Doesn't your family visit the graves?

asEn.guan: Does your household visit the graves too, sir?
asEn.seng: Master, does the temple burn paper money too?

beats.text: 如今都燒紙的，不興厚葬了。
beats.en: It's all paper we burn now. Lavish burials are out.

beats.text: 燒個紙馬，先人那邊也有馬騎。
beats.en: Burn a paper horse, and the departed have one to ride.

beats.text: 紙錢買了，還得買些麥糕。
beats.en: Paper money bought. I still need some wheat cakes.

asEn.guan: Sir, whose wheat cakes are best in town?

beats.en: Around Qingming they sell them all over.

beats.text: 上了墳，就在樹下吃一頓。
beats.en: After the graves, we'll eat under the trees.
Hold steady! We're under way!

asEn.guan: Steady, sir. Plenty of boats ahead.
asEn.tong: Kid, don't hang over the side!
asEn.fu: Madam, please sit in the cabin.
asEn.li: Brother, lend a hand. Pole us off!
asEn.seng: Sit tight, Master. The current's strong here.

beats.en: Boats ahead — give way!
Hold her off! Don't scrape that passenger boat!

beats.text: 他們忙他們的，咱們看景。
beats.en: Let them work. We'll enjoy the view.
Look, on the bank, men hauling a rope!
Heavy cargo, heavy boat. No room for carelessness.

asEn.guan: Forgive us, sir. She's heavy and slow.

beats.en: The channel narrows ahead. Boat against boat.
What's happening out there? Let me look too.

beats.text: 縴夫加把勁，過了這段就好。
beats.en: Trackers, pull harder! Past this stretch it's easy.
First time on the Bian, friend?

asEn.guan: Your first time on a Bian canal boat, sir?

beats.text: 前頭就是虹橋，得早早放桅。
beats.en: The Rainbow Bridge is ahead. Lower the mast early.

beats.text: 就怕縴夫埋頭拉，不看前頭。
beats.en: The worry is trackers pulling head-down, never looking up.
Coming through! Tow rope!

asEn.guan: Mind, sir! Don't trip on the rope!
asEn.tong: Out of the way, kid! The rope cuts!
asEn.fu: Keep to the inside, madam. Careful.

beats.en: Heave — ho!
Step by step. Don't slacken!
This boat's load is heavier than a mountain.

beats.text: 拉一天縴，買不起二斤羊肉。
beats.en: A day's hauling won't buy two jin of mutton.

beats.text: 還在這兒？我們可停不得。
beats.en: Still here? We can't stop.

as.guan: 官人還不走？我們停不得。

asEn.guan: Still here, sir? We can't stop.

beats.en: The rope's rubbing my shoulder raw.

beats.text: 到了橋前就停，叫船上放桅。
beats.en: Short of the bridge we stop and call them to lower the mast.
Mustn't pull head-down past the mark again.

beats.text: 岸上來的？這船快卸完了。
beats.en: Come from the bank? This boat's nearly unloaded.

asEn.guan: What brings you aboard, sir?
asEn.li: Are you a boatman too, brother?
asEn.tong: Little brother, the deck's slippery. Careful.

beats.text: 卸完了，又不知往哪裏去。
beats.en: Once it's unloaded, who knows where we go next.
Don't fret… there's always work in the capital.
I wonder how my old mother is.
Lad, stop moping. Come and help!
Back again? Sit. It's quiet on board.

asEn.guan: Back again, sir? Please sit.

beats.text: 我頭一回跑這麼遠的船。
beats.en: It's my first time sailing so far.
I was the same once…
They say the capital has everything.
Stand back! Mules kick!

as.guan: 官人退後些，騾子性子烈。

asEn.guan: Step back a little, sir. These mules are fiery.
asEn.tong: Kid, don't touch the mule's legs!
asEn.fu: This way, madam. The cart's about to move.

beats.en: Hand up another sack!
The cart's full. Tie it tight.
This load of grain goes into town before noon.
You again? This mule's shy of strangers.

as.guan: 官人又來了，騾子認生，莫靠近。

asEn.guan: You again, sir? The mule's shy. Don't come close.

beats.text: 這馬是東家的，等他回來。
beats.en: This horse is the master's. We wait for him.
Cover it with the mat. Keep the rain off.

beats.text: 進城還得過虹橋，慢慢走。
beats.en: Into town we still cross the Rainbow Bridge. Slow and easy.
Come, sit and have a cup!

as.tong: 小娃兒，這不是你待的地方。
as.jun: 軍爺也來喝兩杯？不當值麼？

asEn.guan: Honour us, sir. Share a cup?
asEn.tong: Kid, this is no place for you.
asEn.fu: Madam, there are quiet seats inside.
asEn.jun: A drink, soldier? Not on duty today?
asEn.shi: A poem by the river, sir?

beats.en: My passenger boat's moored right below.

beats.text: 船主難得上岸，多喝兩杯。
beats.en: A boat-owner rarely comes ashore. Have another.

beats.text: 看，那船叫人拉著往上走。
beats.en: Look, that boat's being hauled upstream.
Drinking alone has its comforts.

beats.text: 客官要坐船？我那船最寬敞。
beats.en: Need a boat, friend? Mine's the roomiest.

as.guan: 官人要坐船？小人的船最體面。

asEn.guan: Need a boat, sir? Mine's the finest.

beats.text: 艙裏有桌，船上就能用飯。
beats.en: There are tables in the cabin. You can dine aboard.
There he goes, praising his boat again.
The Bian right outside. What a view.

asEn.guan: Look, sir, how busy the Bian is.

beats.en: From dawn to dusk, boats come and go.

beats.text: 京城吃的用的，都靠這條河。
beats.en: All the capital eats and uses comes up this river.

beats.text: 客官稍待，我們送個朋友。
beats.en: Wait a moment, friend. We're seeing someone off.

as.guan: 官人見笑，送個遠行的朋友。
as.seng: 師父來得巧，替他念聲平安。

asEn.guan: Forgive us, sir. We're seeing off a friend.
asEn.seng: Good timing, Master. Say a prayer for his journey.
asEn.tong: Kid, keep away from the water.

beats.en: Drain this cup. A fair wind all the way!
Thank you all. We'll meet again.
Uncle, come back soon!
Take a willow sprig, and remember to come back.
Once the boat leaves, he's out of sight.

as.guan: 官人，這一別，不知幾時再見。

asEn.guan: Sir, who knows when we'll meet again after this?

beats.en: If it turns cold on the road, wrap up warm.
I know, I know. Go on home.
Stand clear! The sweep's swinging round!

as.seng: 師父念句經，助我們一把。

asEn.guan: Steady, sir. She rolls hard.
asEn.li: Brother, take a turn at the sweep?
asEn.fu: Don't be afraid, madam. She's steady.
asEn.seng: Master, say a sutra and help us row.

beats.en: Row away — hey!
Heave — ho!
Put your backs in! We're against the current!
A day at the sweep, and only enough to eat.
Aboard again? Hold on.

asEn.guan: Back again, sir? Hold the rail.

beats.en: Stroke by stroke, we'll get there.
Heave — ho — hey!
Once we're past the passenger boat, it's easier.

altsEn: Quick, stack them all on the pile!
Wipe the sweat, then carry on.
No slacking, there's more on the boat.
No rest. Half a boatload left.
The bank's steep. Watch your feet.
This boatload will take till dark.
All the way from the south. Here at last.
What a trip. I'm worn out.
Keep it. Don't lose a single stick.
I know. Tucked in my coat.
One tally a sack. Pay by tallies.
Settle up by tallies this evening.
I'll carry dozens of sacks today.
At this price the master won't lose.
Grain prices will go higher yet.
This grain goes on the cart, into town.
Onto the cart, into town by noon.
For a wine house in town, they say.
A wine house buys it, I hear.
A day of sacks for a few pints of rice.
A whole body of sweat for a mouthful of food.
Push it in. Pack it tight.
That grain on the cart, is it for town?
Once loaded, go. Don't block my door.
Cover it well. Keep the rain off.
So many grain boats on the river today.
Another fleet of grain boats in.
All private. Not an official boat among them.

alts: 官倉空了，糧都進了私倉。
altsEn: State granaries empty, private stores full.
Rice will go up again, I fear.
Your tea's cold. A fresh pot?

alts: 那望火樓上，也沒人看著。
altsEn: Not a soul on the fire tower either.
Wait till noon. It'll be full.
This soup's not bad at all.
Full belly, then back to work.
No more. Any more and I'm drunk.
Look at that boat, hauled along by men.
Against the current. No easy thing.

alts: 我那船上，窗子都是花格的。
我那客船，比這酒樓還講究。
altsEn: My boat has lattice windows all round.
My passenger boat's finer than this tavern.
A jug of wine, a river of water.
Sitting alone watching boats. Pleasant enough.
I'll go up and cast off!
Wait, the passengers aren't all aboard.
Stop shouting. The owner's not back.
The water's such a lovely green.
Steadier on a boat than in a cart.
Are the cabin tables wiped clean?
Supper will be served on board.
How far have we rowed today?

alts: 船上搖櫓，岸上拉縴，都苦。
altsEn: A day at the sweep. Just enough to eat.
Rowing aboard, hauling ashore. Both are hard.
This load's heavier than a mountain.
What's aboard, to weigh so much?
Is that the Rainbow Bridge ahead?
Head down and pull. Never mind ahead.

alts: 拉一天，二斤羊肉也買不起。
altsEn: This straw cape is soaked with sweat.
A day's hauling won't buy two jin of mutton.
Watch it, boat on the left!
Let them get on with it.
Just the window for the view.
Someone's hauling a rope over there!
Catch my breath, then change shifts.
Not for a while. Back in the cabin.
Slow down! Don't scrape our boat!
Hey, big boat, keep further out!
Once it's unloaded we can rest.

alts: 卸完了，又不知往哪裏去。
altsEn: Once it's unloaded, who knows where we go.
I wonder how things are at home.

alts: 客人說請咱們上岸喝兩杯。
altsEn: A cup up in the riverside rooms?
The passenger will stand us drinks ashore.
You go. I'll mind the boat.
Are the casks all tied fast?
I'm leaning on them. Who'd dare?
Hey! That big boat's coming in on us!
Watch out, she'll hit our stern!
What's happened at the Rainbow Bridge?
Didn't get the mast down, maybe.
Look, they're all in a muddle.

alts: 又不是我家的船，看熱鬧罷。
altsEn: Not my boat. I'll just watch.
The rope will sweep past our stern.
Nothing in the way this side.
Resting at the bank. Not bad.
Those trackers have it worse than us.
One more cup: a fair wind all the way.
It's a long way. Take care.
I want to ride the boat too.
So many people on the bank.
They've all come to see us off.
It's cold on the road. Wrap up.
Father, people are pulling ropes on that boat.
That boat over there is huge!
Window open, wine in hand, the Bian below: the best.
This window looks straight onto the river.
A cup of wine, half a day of ease.
Goods from the south. We unload at dawn.
When the master gives the word.

alts: 我鋪裏都要了，價錢好說。
altsEn: My shop will take the lot. We'll agree a price.
The capital's rice all comes through here.

alts: 坐在這棚底下，日頭曬不著。
altsEn: Under this hood the sun can't reach me.
Stay close. Keep away from the water.
Look, they're hauling a boat over there.
Father, shall we go and see the Rainbow Bridge?
Are there many people on the bridge?
Any cheaper and I lose money.
Sit and have a bowl of tea.
No, I must be on my way.
Why all the noise over there?
What's going on by the river now?
Lots of boats. Happens all the time.
Where do these two crates go?
Is it something alive in the crates?
To the eatery at the east end.
I'll pick a few. Make it cheaper.
All off the boats this morning.
We can talk, we can talk.
Mm, let me pick some more.

alts: 郊外一匹馬驚了，好嚇人！
altsEn: A horse bolted out in the fields. Frightful!
A horse bolted outside town just now.

alts: 幸好有人把孩子喚回去了。
altsEn: Luckily someone called the children in.
Charged into the market, crashing about.
The donkey got a fright back there too.
It hasn't got over it yet.
News from outside town travels fast.
You two came from the country, bound for town?
Rested enough to go into town?
Baggage off. We rest, then go.
Why's nobody up on the fire tower?
Not even a lookout up there.

alts: 上頭擺了桌凳，喝茶的地方。
altsEn: Long since made a pavilion for cooling off.
Tables and stools up there now. For tea.
This eatery was barracks once, wasn't it?
Selling meals now. Livelier than soldiers.
If a fire broke out, who'd raise the alarm?
Let's hope no fire breaks out.
Hold it steady. Don't drop it.
Cool under the awning. Come and look.
Empty baskets. Into town to find work.
Into town, to carry for folk.
Another one off to town to make a living.
Wang's paper horses. This is the place.
A bowl of hot broth to ease the weariness!
Have a bowl of water before you go!

guan: Sir, a bowl of hot broth?
li: Brother, a bowl of water, one coin.
seng: Master, a bowl of water. No charge.

guan: Don't scorn small wine, sir. It quenches thirst!
li: Brother, small wine's cheap. You can afford it!

altsEn: Come and sit in the eatery, friend!
Seats inside. Hot food, hot soup!

li: Brother, eat your fill, then back to the sacks!

altsEn: This pole's heavy. Hold it steady.
Hang the pennants higher. It draws customers.
River god, keep us safe on the way.
The river god honoured. Now we can sail.
The sun's harsh. Pull the hat down.

alts: 那船吃水淺了，快卸完了。
altsEn: That boat's riding high. Nearly unloaded.
This one done, the next one after.
Come in and see the goods, friend.
Fine goods from the south, sold cheap.

guan: Please come in, sir. See the goods.
fu: Have a look, madam. Just in.

altsEn: Once she's unloaded she'll ride light.
